title: Put Your Name on Your Game, a Talk by Bennett Foddy and Zach Gage
summary: At GDC 2019, Bennett Foddy and Zach Gage ask why game developers rarely sign their work. They argue that indie developers could benefit from putting their names on their games.
why: HN recommends it when people ask why games aren't marketed by creator like films, and for the value of attaching your name to your work.

quote.text: Great talk on that from the GettingOverIt/QWOP dev
